description: This file defines the 'Order' entity class used in the sales management system. It models the order details such as status, date, total, customer info, associated products, order history, billing, delivery, payment info, and relationships with other entities like merchant store and currency.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Entity class representing a customer's order, capturing order details, status, associated products, billing, delivery, payment info, and relationships with merchant store and currency.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the order.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the order.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the order.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the order.

methods.name: getLastModified
methods.description: Returns a cloned copy of the last modified timestamp.

methods.name: getDatePurchased
methods.description: Returns a cloned copy of the purchase date.

methods.name: getOrderDateFinished
methods.description: Returns a cloned copy of the order completion date.

methods.name: getCurrencyValue
methods.description: Returns the exchange rate value applied to the order.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total amount of the order.

methods.name: setTotal
methods.description: Sets the total amount of the order.

methods.name: getIpAddress
methods.description: Returns the IP address from which the order was placed.

methods.name: getPaymentModuleCode
methods.description: Returns the code of the payment module used.

methods.name: getMerchant
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with the order.

methods.name: setMerchant
methods.description: Sets the merchant store for the order.

methods.name: getOrderProducts
methods.description: Returns the set of products included in the order.

methods.name: setOrderProducts
methods.description: Sets the products included in the order.

methods.name: getOrderHistory
methods.description: Returns the history of order status changes.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale of the order.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale of the order.
